description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/flux_limiter_minmod_D_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic_minmod.esm (model AdvectionMinmod), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)). The limiter is second-order where it is inactive, but CLIPS at the sin's two smooth extrema, so the OBSERVED order is below 2 and differs between norms (L2 converges faster than Linf, whose extremum-localized error dominates). expected_order/order_tolerance bracket both observed norm orders honestly; the design order (2) is the rule's `order:` tag, the observed order is here.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: No Rust tolerance both terminates and passes: it terminates only at reltol >= 1e-8 (looser hangs the diffsol integrator -- no dtmin/max-step guard), but at 1e-8 its temporal error exceeds the 1e-4 errors-vs-golden tolerance vs the Julia reference; a tolerance tight enough to meet the gate hangs. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) verify it.
